issues.message: Headline is truncated to 'BUY ETFs COMM' — the words 'COMMISSION FREE' are cut off mid-word. Core message is lost.
Variant fails to convey the source's full headline 'BUY ETFs COMMISSION FREE'. Although source itself clips at the right edge, the variant truncates much earlier, removing the key value proposition.
CTA pill extends past the right edge of the canvas; the label 'START INVESTING' is clipped to 'START INVE...TING'.
With the headline truncated mid-word, the CTA and headline compete for attention rather than establishing a clear primary→secondary reading order.

notes: Brand palette, logo, and disclaimer treatment are preserved, but the headline truncation is a blocking issue. CTA clipping is inherited from the source but still degrades quality.
